name: Seated exercise routine
pitch: Designs a seated exercise routine that maintains strength and circulation for limited mobility.
instructions: Start by searching for 'seated exercises limited mobility strength circulation'. Read the top results and note down 3 to 5 safe, effective movements that need no equipment. When no suitable exercises are found, say so and ask the person if they want to try different search terms. Create a simple text page with the routine: a warm-up, 3 exercises with 10 repetitions each, and a cool-down. Include a note that the person should stop if they feel pain. Save the page to their workspace. When the page is saved, show it to the person and ask if they want any changes or if they are happy with it.

examples.ask: can you make a seated exercise routine
examples.does: searches for safe seated exercises and creates a simple routine page

skills.name: find-safe-exercises
skills.description: Search the web for seated exercises suitable for limited mobility. Read the top results. Note down 3 to 5 movements that improve strength and circulation and need no equipment. When nothing is found or all results look unsafe, say so and ask the person if they want to try different search terms.
skills.body: 1. Use web_search with the query 'seated exercises limited mobility strength circulation'. 2. Read the top results with browser_snapshot. 3. Select 3 to 5 exercises that are safe, need no equipment, and target strength and circulation. 4. If no exercises are suitable, stop and tell the person. 5. Remember the chosen exercises for the next step.

readme:
# Seated exercise routine
Designs a seated exercise routine that maintains strength and circulation for limited mobility.

What it needs: web_search to find exercises, make_page to create the routine, file_write to save it.

What it will not do: it will not give medical advice or tell the person to ignore pain.
